name: Jellyfin Oscars
description: Jellyfin server plugin that enriches movie metadata with Oscar (Academy Awards) information.
overview: Adds Oscar metadata, badges, and optional collections to Jellyfin movies.

versions.changelog: Remove legacy direct Jellyfin Web/index.html patching, switch badge injection to JavaScript Injector only, add visible badge integration status in plugin settings, and improve startup resilience when JavaScript Injector is missing.
